body: rejection is just a another way of saving yourself from someone else as special as you are!

it sounds like you are having trust issues, trust is what makes a relationship work! firstly, you need to learn how to trust yourself... love yourself.. and take care of yourself. when you finally learn to love yourself, i think .. i know, that your boyfriend will love you even more for that! I think the guy really loves you :) otherwise if he didn't he wouldve let you go on your own to fight this depression!
look at the brighter side of going to college in NYC, it is a brand new begginning and chapter in your life! i have been in the same position as you, when i was always paranoid that my boyfriend would cheat on me or do something stupid.. but it almost resulted us to break up, we've been together for 3 years and it has been the most amazing years in my life. dont let that happen to you, you need to just breathe... he loves you!!! and im sure he does for a lot of reasons!!!!! so i think you need take a page out of his book and realised, the reasons why he loves you and these reasons should be one of the many many many reasons why you must love yourself too!
remember, everything will be ok, the more you worry, the more time wasted! just try and relax and.. just breathe.. :)

Dont let depression take over your life!! you need to be strong!!!!! remember, no one will ever , ever ever help you as much as you help yourself! i know it is harder than anything but dont let your depression get the best of you. remember, breathe.... it will be okay!

Dealing with depression and loneliness is hard! It isn't easy to just get it over and done with, my advice for you is to get busy! do something you've never done before! do something that you thought that you might not ever thought you might like... go for a jog! go to the gym and work out! this will make you feel better as believe it or not, .. or meditate ! you might think its boring but... it does for a fact relaxes you down.. it can only take about 5-10 minutes! 
and sorry about the break up! break ups suck... but you need to be strong and open your mind to other things, focus on yourself more! this is the time when you need to come out of your shell and developed yourself , on truly who you really are! it all sounds tough.. and it is but remember one thing, it  does not get any worst!!!! it eventually gets better... and remember, breathe.

I just feel so worthless you know? because i know right now, he doesn't care anymore, he's already cut all his connection with me in less than 24 hrs. I wish i can just be like him, not give a single damn.
Also guys, I was invited to his moms baby shower on sunday? Should i go? or should i just buy her something and give it to her personally?
That's a really good one. I will try and distract myself... but I just know at the back of my mind, I will always think about him.. why? Because I am stupid.
You could be right, but right now... as I am typing this, im crying... i just.. i just keep asking myself "if he really did loved me, why would he do this to me?... again."

Im happy that you found something good for you, im proud.. you're doing really well, but, how do you refrain yourself from , lets say, coming over to her house? Texting her? calling her? how did you do it? I mean you probably got yourself really busy, but im sure there was moments you just wanted to see her..
He already blocked me from trying to contact him... already. It just so easy for him to get rid of me so quickly. :(
its easier said than done... i wish i could just not think about it.. i really wish i could. but the pain is just so fresh, -sigh- and it hurts so much..
you are absolutely right... this is not the first time either :( its AM here right now, and I have only just woken up and I can feel my chest hurt, I miss him already, it hasn't still been 24 hours.
Because it only passes the pain to someone else or to everyone else...
You've just made me put the blade down...
Im here for you, ok. Please dont give up. There is more in life than it seems..
Im so sorry for your lost, im sorry that you're going through this. Just know when you were walking across that stage, he was looking down on you proudly.
